title: Habit Tracker with Streaks
description: Build a habit tracker that logs daily entries, calculates streaks, and generates weekly reports.

steps.title: Define the habit and log data structures
steps.description: Create a `habits` array with objects containing `id`, `name`, `frequency` (times per week), and `goal` (target days). Also create an empty `log` object. Log the structures.
hints: Log the habits array and log object with JSON.stringify

verification.successMessage: Habit data structures are ready with id, name, frequency, and goal!
verification.failureMessage: Create a habits array with at least 2 habit objects and an empty log object.

steps.title: Implement logEntry function
steps.description: Write a `logEntry` function that takes a `date` string, `habitId`, and `completed` boolean. It records the entry in the log object. Log the updated log.
hints: If the date doesn't exist in log, create it: log[date] = {}

verification.successMessage: Entries can be logged to the habit tracker!
verification.failureMessage: logEntry should record the date, habitId, and completion status in the log object.

steps.title: Calculate consecutive day streak
steps.description: Write a `getStreak` function that takes a `habitId` and returns the number of consecutive days (going backward from today) that the habit was completed. Log the streak.
hints: Start from today and go backward day by day
Check if log[date] and log[date][habitId] are both true
Stop at the first missed day and return the count

verification.successMessage: Streak calculation counts consecutive completed days!
verification.failureMessage: getStreak('exercise') should return 3 for the given log (Jan 15, 14, 13 are all true, Jan 12 is false).

steps.title: Calculate completion rate
steps.description: Write a `completionRate` function that takes a `habitId` and a number of `days`, and returns the percentage of days the habit was completed. Log the result.
hints: Loop through the last N days
Count completed days where log[date][habitId] === true
Return Math.round((completed / totalDays) * 100) or round in Python

verification.successMessage: Completion rate calculates the correct percentage!
verification.failureMessage: completionRate('exercise', 4) should return 75 (3 out of 4 days completed).

steps.title: Generate a weekly report summary
steps.description: Write a `weeklyReport` function that takes a `habitId` and returns a summary string: `"Week report for exercise: 4/7 days (57%)"`. Also include the current streak.
hints: Calculate completed days in the last 7 days
Format: 'Week report for ' + name + ': ' + completed + '/7 days (' + percent + '%)'
Append the streak info: ' | Streak: ' + streak + ' days'

verification.successMessage: Weekly report generates with days completed, percentage, and streak!
verification.failureMessage: weeklyReport should format as 'Week report for exercise: 5/7 days (71%) | Streak: 3 days'.
